measurement: workspace quality gates (fmt, metadata, dependency rules, clippy, workspace tests)
head: 90abe30870aa9288e4aab69383c68cceedff63f5
result: All six documented gate commands pass on this commit: fmt clean, metadata parses, the dependency-rule checker and its self-test pass for seven workspace members, clippy over the whole workspace with warnings-as-errors is clean, and cargo test --workspace passes every binary (desktop-gpui 104, media 75 across ten binaries, others 11).
why: The individual slices were verified per crate as they were written. This run covers the workspace as a whole, so the added dev-dependency, the direct png edge and the new test binaries are exercised together under the documented gate commands.
what_this_is_not: It is not product acceptance, not a native/GUI verification, and not the independent Refine Gate - the Gate is run separately against a pinned commit.
